Gill Smashes ODI Double Century Record, Surpassing Kishan

Shubman Gill has broken Ishan Kishan's record for the fastest double century in One Day Internationals (ODIs). Gill achieved this feat during a match against Sri Lanka, surpassing Kishan's previous record of 126 balls set against Bangladesh in Chattogram in 2022. The Indian team secured a historic victory over Sri Lanka, with multiple records being set during the match, including Gill's double hundred.
